shape_prior: Known metric CAD convex hull; upright/typical orientation estimated only from fold-fit quaternions
oracle_input: Visible instance segmentation including physical identity. No GT test position/depth/rotation is supplied to fitting. Current image detector not trained.
limitations: Convex projected outline, fixed fit orientation, partial visible masks may distort bbox/contour. These finite fitters are conditional oracle diagnostics, not best possible use of silhouette. No GT-assisted initialization or result selection.
failed_observation_policy: Less than4 mask pixels -> missing. Report valid counts; full population summary explicitly falls back to old shared predictions, not hidden case dropping.
